FULL TEXT:
POPULATION RESEARCH CENTRE
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
(NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”)
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
www.prcku.uok.edu.in Email: directorprc@uok.edu.in
Advertisement Notice No. 14 of 2026
Dated: 08-05-2026
The Population Research Centre, Srinagar invites applications for the posts of Associate Professor
(01 post) under University of Kashmir, Srinagar-190006 (J&K), accredited Grade „A++‟ by
NAAC. The details of post, emoluments and qualification are as under:
Name, Number of
Post with Reservation
and Post Code
Pay Level (Rs)
Qualifications and Other Essential
Requirements
Associate Professor
(01 post- UR)
Post Code:
PGD-PR-6
Level 13A, Rs.
131400-217100/-
1. A Master's Degree in Demography/ Population
Studies/ Statistics/ Economics/ Mathematics/
Sociology/ Psychology/ Anthropology/
Geography with at least 55% marks or an
equivalent grade in a point scale, wherever
grading system is followed;
2. Persons with Post Graduation Degree other than
Demography/ Population studies should have
completed a minimum of one year regular
course in Demography/ Population studies at a
recognized institution/ University;
3. A good academic record with a Ph.D. Degree in
the subjects mentioned at Point No. 01;
4. Published Research work of good quality on
any aspect of Demography & Health;
5. A minimum of eight years of experience of
teaching and/ or research in an academic/
research position equivalent to that of Assistant
Professor in a University, College or Accredited
Research Institution/ Industry with a minimum
of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or
UGC listed journals and a total
Academic/Research score of seventy-five (75)
as per the criteria given below in Appendix II,
Table 2 of UGC Guidelines, July, 2018.
 The posts are temporary and likely to continue with the continuation of the
Population Research Centre at the University of Kashmir, J&K by the Ministry of
Health and Family Welfare.
 Further Information can be had from the office of the Coordinator, Population Research
Centre through E-mail: directorprc@uok.edu.in.
I) IMPORTANT DATES:
I Submission of Online Forms/ Hard Copy from 13th May, 2026
II Last date for Submission of Online Forms 12th June, 2026
III Last date for submission of Hard copy 16th June, 2026
II) PERCENTAGE EQUIVALENCE OF GRADE POINTS FOR A SEVEN POINT SCALE:
In the Seven Point Scale with letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E & F, “B” shall be regarded as
equivalent of 55%, wherever the grading system is followed:
Grade Grade Point %age Equivalent
O=Outstanding 5.50-6.00 75-100
A=Very Good 4.50-5.49 65-74
B=Good 3.50-4.49 55-64
C=Average 2.50-3.49 45-54
D=Below Average 1.50-2.49 35-44
E=Poor 0.50-1.49 25-34
F=Fail 0.00-0.49 00-24
A relaxation of 5% may be provided from 55% to 50% of the marks to the Ph.D. Degree
holders, who have obtained their Master’s Degree prior to 19th September, 1991.
III) SUBMISSION OF ON-LINE APPLICATION FORMS:
Step 1: Visit http://www.kashmiruniversity.ac.in and Click on Jobs/Recruitment
link. Read detailed important Instructions and Preview of whole process for
Registration and submission of Application Form before proceeding ahead.
Step 2: Candidate needs to register himself/herself before submitting the Online
Application. For Registration, Click on the Register as an Applicant link.
Remember the Username and Password for future reference. Use valid Email
id and mobile during registration process.
Step 3: After successful Registration, Login into the system by using your Username
and Password.
Step 4: Key in the personal details, educational qualifications, experience etc then
Preview the Form. If details are correct, Click on Submit. If there are
variations or you want to update, Click on Preview button, make corrections,
updating and then Submit. Remember, no editing or updating is allowed
after the Form is submitted. Get a print out and note the Form No. for future
reference.
Step 5: Deposit the Application Fee of Rs. 1200/-, through Online mode only.
However, the persons with benchmark disabilities (PwD) are exempted from
payment of application fee.
IV) SUBMISSION OF DOWNLOADED APPLICATION FORMS (HARD COPY)
Submit a Print-out of the Application Form submitted online along with the enclosures,
duly numbered at right hand top margin, as per the auto-generated serial numbers against
each entry, online payment acknowledgement, properly bound, either personally or
through Speed Post/ Registered Post to the Office of the Recruitment Section, New
Admin Block, University of Kashmir, Hazratbal, Srinagar-190006, J&K.
Candidates sending print-out of their Application Forms by post should ensure that the
envelope containing Application Form is super-scribed as “Application for the post of
………………………, Post ID ………… Advertisement notice No. ………. Dated
………….” and reaches by or before the last date. Application Form received by post
after the last date shall be rejected summarily without any notice in this regard.
V) GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
a) In addition to Pay Band/ Pay Level, D.A. Medical Allowance, House Rent and other
allowances as admissible to the staff of the Population Research Centre is payable to the
appointees.
b) The appointee is not entitled to GP fund/ pension, however, Contributory Provident Fund/
NPS/ gratuity and leave encashment will be applicable to the appointee as permissible
under rules/ guidelines of the Ministry.
c) Terms and conditions of appointment of the candidates shall be governed by the
provisions of the Kashmir & Jammu Universities Act, 1969, and Statutes & Regulations
made there under from time to time, and the Union Ministry of Health and Family
Welfare, UGC, whichever applicable.
d) The University reserves the right not to fill up the post advertised, if circumstances so
warrant, without assigning any reason thereof.
e) No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview.
f) Only those candidates should apply for the posts, who fulfill the eligibility criteria on or
before the last date of submission of applications.
g) Applications received late or not in proper format or incomplete in any respect shall not
be entertained.
h) Applications by Government servants should be sent through the Administrative
Authority concerned. In the case of the University Teachers/Employees, through the
Registrar of their respective University and in the case of persons employed in the private
firms and Institutions through the Head of the firm/institutions concerned.
APPLICATIONS NOT ROUTED THROUGH THE RESPECTIVE CHANNELS
ARE LIABLE TO BE REJECTED. However such candidates are advised not to wait
for the last date and an advance copy may be sent at the earliest followed by application
through proper channel.
i) Canvassing in any form by or on behalf of the candidate will be a disqualification.
j) Impersonation or submission of false/ fabricated/ tampered documents or making
incorrect/false statements by a candidate, will, render him/her liable for criminal
prosecution.
k) All enclosures attached with the Application Form should be self attested and the
candidates shall have to produce the original documents relating to their age,
qualifications, experience, fitness and other claims whatsoever at the time of interview.
l) The candidates are advised to write their name strictly as per Matriculation/ Higher
Secondary Certificates.
m) The interview call letter/s shall be sent through E-mail/ SMS on the e.mail address and
mobile number mentioned in the respective application form/s.
n) The University shall verify the antecedents of all documents of the candidates submitted
at any time of appointment or during the tenure of service. In case, it is detected that the
documents submitted are fake or the candidate has a clandestine antecedents/ background
and has suppressed the said information, his/her services shall be terminated forthwith
and the action shall be taken as warranted under rules.
o) Addendum/ Corrigendum/ Notice regarding this advertisement shall be uploaded on the
University/ PRC website only.
p) In case large number of applications are received, the short listing shall be carried out for
which scheme will be notified separately.
q) Candidates are advised to regularly check University/ PRC website for latest updates/
important instructions, released by the University from time to time. No separate
intimation in this regard shall be given.
r) The post is being re-advertised due to poor response of the eligible candidates in response
to earlier advertisement notice dated 27-12-2024. As such, the candidate/s who have
applied for the said post against the earlier advertisement need to apply afresh against this
advertisement for consideration of their candidature, if otherwise eligible.
VI) OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
a. A candidate should have a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or
UGC listed journals and a total Academic/ Research score of seventy five (75) as
per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Guidelines, July, 2018.
b. Any publications in predatory/ dubious journals or presentations in
predatory/dubious conferences shall not be considered for academic credit for
selection and confirmation. With effect from 14.6.2019, research publications
from journals indexed in UGC-CARE Listed Journals/ Scopus/ Web of Science
listed Journals only would be considered for all academic purposes.
c. Each API score must be supported by the documentary evidence in the Performance
Based Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma, without which no claim on account of
Academic/ Research Score will be entertained. It is mandatory that the candidate
mark Page No./s on all the supporting documents as in the Application Form.
d. The details with regard to ISSN/ISBN, sole author/Coauthors/Joint publication,
refereed/non-refereed/ indexed/ non-indexed and local/ national/ international status
etc. must also be reflected in the publication part of PBAS proforma supported by
documentary evidence.
e. Documents required to be submitted along with Hard Copy of complete application
form:
i. A self-addressed envelope bearing postage stamp worth Rs. 50/-
ii. One (1) set of Performance Based Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma,
four (04) copies of latest Bio-data along with and four (04) copies of seven
(07) best publications as books and / or research/policy papers (which shall
not be in any case attached to PBAS Proforma), in spiral binding only,
along with other documents.
f. Candidates who have been awarded post graduate/Ph.D. degree from Foreign
University should enclose “Equivalence Certificate” issued by Association of
Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi without which their candidature shall not be
considered and application form shall be rejected.
Sd/-
REGISTRAR
